name: Paachan Sheel – After-Meal Kadha Powder for Teens (150 g)
short_description:
Heavy tummy after lunch? Sleepy in afternoon class? Paachan Sheel is the Indian family's after-meal saunf-jeera habit, turned into a warm 2-minute sip. Seven kitchen spices – fennel, cumin, dry ginger, ajwain, coriander, mulethi and black pepper – that support healthy digestion, ease bloating and help your teen feel light after every meal.

  • Supports digestion, gut comfort and less bloating
  • Caffeine-free, no added sugar, no preservatives
  • Freshly ground and packed after you order
description:
The after-lunch sip that keeps tummies light and minds awake

Teen tummies take a beating – rushed school lunches, canteen snacks, late-night maggi, hours of sitting. Indian grandmothers solved this long ago: a pinch of saunf, jeera and ajwain after food. Paachan Sheel puts that wisdom into one simple cup your teen will actually drink.

Two promises in every pouch

  • Fresh from the source. Whole spices and herbs bought directly from farms and trusted growers – never stale warehouse stock.
  • Made to order, like a mother makes for her own children. We roast, grind and pack your pouch only after you order, in small batches, in a hygienic home kitchen. No colours, no preservatives, nothing you can't pronounce.

What's inside – and what each ingredient does

  • Fennel seeds (saunf) (30.0%) – India's favourite after-meal seed. Its natural oils (anethole) help relax the gut, ease gas and freshen breath.
  • Cumin (jeera) (25.3%) – Traditionally used to support digestive enzymes and a comfortable, settled stomach.
  • Dry ginger (saunth) (14.7%) – Warming root that supports digestion and helps relieve that heavy, bloated feeling.
  • Ajwain (10.0%) – Thymol-rich seed long trusted in Indian homes for gas, acidity and tummy aches.
  • Coriander seeds (10.0%) – Cooling and soothing; balances the warmth of the other spices.
  • Mulethi (licorice root) (5.3%) – Natural sweetness and a soothing coat for the stomach lining.
  • Black pepper (4.7%) – Wakes up digestion and helps the body absorb what it eats.

How and when to take it

Stir ½ tsp (about 2 g) into 100 ml warm water. Sip slowly within 10–15 minutes after lunch (or after dinner on heavy days). One pack ≈ 75 cups.

Good to know

Net weight 150 g. Store in a cool, dry place and close the zip tightly after use. Use-by date is printed on the pouch.

Contains licorice root – do not exceed one serving twice a day. Not a medicine. Consult a doctor if pregnant, nursing, on medication or under medical care.

name: Sashakt – Morning Vitality Milk Blend for Teens (150 g)
short_description:

  • Roasted makhana (fox nut) (44.7%) – Light, crunchy lotus seed rich in plant protein, magnesium and calcium – supports strong bones and muscles.

  • Moringa leaf (10.0%) – The 'miracle tree' – naturally rich in iron, calcium and vitamin A; supports energy and immunity.

name: Drishtisheel – Amla, Moringa & Carrot Eye-Nourish Kadha (150 g)
short_description:
Online classes, phones, gaming – your teen's eyes never rest. Drishtisheel is a tangy daily cup of amla, moringa, carrot and fennel – nature's richest sources of vitamin A, vitamin C and antioxidants. Supports healthy eyesight, reduces the effects of screen strain and nourishes tired eyes from within.

  • Supports better eyesight and eye health
  • Packed with vitamin A, vitamin C and antioxidants
  • No colours, no preservatives – lightly sweetened with mishri
description:
Six hours of screens a day. Give those eyes something back.

Indian teens now spend 6–8 hours a day on screens. Dry, tired, strained eyes are becoming normal. Drishtisheel feeds the eyes the nutrients they need, and comes with a simple screen habit that makes a real difference.

Two promises in every pouch

  • Fresh from the source. Whole spices and herbs bought directly from farms and trusted growers – never stale warehouse stock.
  • Made to order, like a mother makes for her own children. We roast, grind and pack your pouch only after you order, in small batches, in a hygienic home kitchen. No colours, no preservatives, nothing you can't pronounce.

What's inside – and what each ingredient does

  • Amla (Indian gooseberry) (34.7%) – One of the richest natural sources of vitamin C – an antioxidant that protects the eye's delicate tissues.
  • Moringa leaf (20.0%) – Naturally rich in vitamin A and lutein, nutrients that support clear vision.
  • Carrot (20.0%) – The classic eye food – beta-carotene converts to vitamin A, which supports night vision and healthy eyes.
  • Fennel seeds (saunf) (15.3%) – Traditionally prized in Ayurveda for the eyes ('chakshushya'); antioxidant-rich.

Stir 1 tsp (about 3 g) into 100 ml warm water, or mix with a little honey and take raw. Once daily, morning or after school. Pair with the 20-20-20 habit: every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds. One pack ≈ 50 servings.

Net weight 150 g. Store in a cool, dry place and close the zip tightly after use. Best within 6 months of packing.

Not a medicine and not a substitute for an eye test or prescribed glasses. Consult a doctor if pregnant, nursing, on medication or under medical care.
